info.title: Cisco Meraki Dashboard API — licensing
info.description: The licensing operations of the Cisco Meraki Dashboard API, split by product area from Cisco's published OpenAPI definition.

x-provenance.note: Split by first tag from Cisco's published spec3.json; operations unmodified.

parameters.description: Filter to entitlements with the specified SKUs

productType.description: The product type of the entitlement

productClass.description: The product class associated with the entitlement

featureTier.description: The feature tier associated with the entitlement (null for add-ons)

isFree.description: Whether or not the entitlement is granted for free

get.summary: Retrieve the list of purchasable entitlements

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: The number of entries per page returned. Acceptable range is 3 - 1000. Default is 1000.

parameters.name: startingAfter
parameters.description: A token used by the server to indicate the start of the page. Often this is a timestamp or an ID but it is not limited to those. This parameter should not be defined by client applications. The link for the first, last, prev, or next page in the HTTP Link header should define it.

parameters.name: endingBefore
parameters.description: A token used by the server to indicate the end of the page. Often this is a timestamp or an ID but it is not limited to those. This parameter should not be defined by client applications. The link for the first, last, prev, or next page in the HTTP Link header should define it.

parameters.description: Search for subscription name

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter subscriptions by start date, ISO 8601 format. To filter with a range of dates, use 'startDate[<option>]=?' in the request. Accepted options include lt, gt, lte, gte.

lt.description: comparative operator used to filter for all values less than the given value

gt.description: comparative operator used to filter for all values greater than the given value

lte.description: comparative operator used to filter for all values less than or equal to the given value

gte.description: comparative operator used to filter for all values greater than or equal to the given value

neq.description: comparative operator used to filter for all values not equal to the given value

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter subscriptions by end date, ISO 8601 format. To filter with a range of dates, use 'endDate[<option>]=?' in the request. Accepted options include lt, gt, lte, gte.

lt.description: comparative operator used to filter for all values less than the given value

gt.description: comparative operator used to filter for all values greater than the given value

lte.description: comparative operator used to filter for all values less than or equal to the given value

gte.description: comparative operator used to filter for all values greater than or equal to the given value

neq.description: comparative operator used to filter for all values not equal to the given value
